files.README.md:
# exposed-mysql-decided-cursor-by-table-optional

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: entities and table objects for Exposed 1.6.1, repositories and services, in Kotlin on the JVM. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no web framework.

## Settings

- Database: mysql.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return the entities; updates take an Optional per field: null when not sent, Optional.empty() to empty it.
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages after a key (cursor).

## Layout

```text
src/main/kotlin/app/AppDatabase.kt      the connection of DATABASE_URL
src/main/kotlin/app/UnitOfWork.kt       the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/main/kotlin/app/errors/             NotFoundException, ConflictException, ValidationFailedException: no HTTP codes
src/main/kotlin/app/<table>/            entity, table object, repositories and service of each table
src/test/kotlin/app/                    repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json                      what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
TEST_DATABASE_URL="jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/app" TEST_DATABASE_USER=app TEST_DATABASE_PASSWORD=app gradle test   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

package app

import app.auditlog.AuditLogRepository
import app.auditlog.MemoryAuditLogRepository
import app.categories.CategoryRepository
import app.categories.MemoryCategoryRepository
import app.customers.CustomerRepository
import app.customers.MemoryCustomerRepository
import app.orderlines.MemoryOrderLineRepository
import app.orderlines.OrderLineRepository
import app.orders.MemoryOrderRepository
import app.orders.OrderRepository
import app.products.MemoryProductRepository
import app.products.ProductRepository
import app.producttags.MemoryProductTagRepository
import app.producttags.ProductTagRepository
import app.tags.MemoryTagRepository
import app.tags.TagRepository

/** The in-memory repositories, for tests and for trying the services without a database. */
class MemoryUnitOfWork : UnitOfWork {
    override val customers: CustomerRepository = MemoryCustomerRepository()
    override val categories: CategoryRepository = MemoryCategoryRepository()
    override val products: ProductRepository = MemoryProductRepository()
    override val orders: OrderRepository = MemoryOrderRepository()
    override val orderLines: OrderLineRepository = MemoryOrderLineRepository()
    override val tags: TagRepository = MemoryTagRepository()
    override val productTags: ProductTagRepository = MemoryProductTagRepository()
    override val auditLog: AuditLogRepository = MemoryAuditLogRepository()

    /** Memory has no transactions: changes are kept as they are made. */
    override fun <T> transaction(work: (UnitOfWork) -> T): T = work(this)
}

package app

import app.auditlog.AuditLogRepository
import app.auditlog.SqlAuditLogRepository
import app.categories.CategoryRepository
import app.categories.SqlCategoryRepository
import app.customers.CustomerRepository
import app.customers.SqlCustomerRepository
import app.orderlines.OrderLineRepository
import app.orderlines.SqlOrderLineRepository
import app.orders.OrderRepository
import app.orders.SqlOrderRepository
import app.products.ProductRepository
import app.products.SqlProductRepository
import app.producttags.ProductTagRepository
import app.producttags.SqlProductTagRepository
import app.tags.SqlTagRepository
import app.tags.TagRepository
import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.jdbc.Database
import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.jdbc.transactions.transaction as exposedTransaction

/** The repositories over one database, and its transaction. */
class SqlUnitOfWork(val db: Database) : UnitOfWork {
    override val customers: CustomerRepository = SqlCustomerRepository(db)
    override val categories: CategoryRepository = SqlCategoryRepository(db)
    override val products: ProductRepository = SqlProductRepository(db)
    override val orders: OrderRepository = SqlOrderRepository(db)
    override val orderLines: OrderLineRepository = SqlOrderLineRepository(db)
    override val tags: TagRepository = SqlTagRepository(db)
    override val productTags: ProductTagRepository = SqlProductTagRepository(db)
    override val auditLog: AuditLogRepository = SqlAuditLogRepository(db)

    /** Joins the transaction already open, or opens one. */
    override fun <T> transaction(work: (UnitOfWork) -> T): T = exposedTransaction(db) { work(this@SqlUnitOfWork) }
}

package app

import app.auditlog.AuditLogRepository
import app.categories.CategoryRepository
import app.customers.CustomerRepository
import app.orderlines.OrderLineRepository
import app.orders.OrderRepository
import app.products.ProductRepository
import app.producttags.ProductTagRepository
import app.tags.TagRepository

/** What services depend on: a repository per table and a transaction. Each service operation runs in transaction(): committed when it ends, rolled back when it throws. */
interface UnitOfWork {
    val customers: CustomerRepository
    val categories: CategoryRepository
    val products: ProductRepository
    val orders: OrderRepository
    val orderLines: OrderLineRepository
    val tags: TagRepository
    val productTags: ProductTagRepository
    val auditLog: AuditLogRepository

    /** Runs work with the repositories of the transaction; commits when it ends, rolls back when it throws. */
    fun <T> transaction(work: (UnitOfWork) -> T): T
}

package app.auditlog

import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.core.Table
import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.javatime.timestampWithTimeZone

/**
 * The "audit_log" table, as the database has it. Exposed never creates or changes it: the database already exists.
 *
 * It has no primary key: its rows are told apart by all their columns.
 */
object AuditLogTable : Table("audit_log") {
    val at = timestampWithTimeZone("at")
    val message = text("message")
}

package app.customers

import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.core.Table
import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.javatime.CurrentTimestampWithTimeZone
import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.javatime.timestampWithTimeZone

/**
 * The "customers" table, as the database has it. Exposed never creates or changes it: the database already exists.
 */
object CustomerTable : Table("customers") {
    val id = long("id").autoIncrement()
    val email = varchar("email", 120)
    val passwordHash = text("password_hash")
    val createdAt = timestampWithTimeZone("created_at").defaultExpression(CurrentTimestampWithTimeZone)

    override val primaryKey = PrimaryKey(id)

    init {
        uniqueIndex("uq_customers_email", email)
    }
}

object OrderLineTable : Table("order_lines") {
    val orderId = long("order_id")
    val line = integer("line")
    val productId = long("product_id")

    init {

package app.products

import app.categories.CategoryTable
import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.core.Table
import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.javatime.timestampWithTimeZone

/**
 * The "products" table, as the database has it. Exposed never creates or changes it: the database already exists.
 *
 * CHECK (price >= 0): the services check what they understand of it.
 */
object ProductTable : Table("products") {
    val id = long("id").autoIncrement()
    val categoryId = long("category_id")
    val name = varchar("name", 100)
    val price = decimal("price", 10, 2)
    val status = varchar("status", 10)
    val version = integer("version").default(1)
    val deletedAt = timestampWithTimeZone("deleted_at").nullable()

    override val primaryKey = PrimaryKey(id)

    init {
        index("ix_products_status", false, status)
        index(null, false, categoryId)
        foreignKey(categoryId to CategoryTable.id, name = "fk_products_category")
    }
}
